Kim / Soojin — quick technical sizing: 

- Estimated log egress and storage based on Cloudwave9s reported traffic: ~30 TB/month of application logs (90d retention => ~90 TB stored across tiers with compression), admin audit trails are ~1.2 TB/yr.
- Export options: bulk snapshot (scheduled daily deltas) or streaming export to Cloudwave S3. Streaming has higher egress but faster for auditor access.
- Impact to latency: negligible for most requests if we use our KV prefix caching + async archiver. Dedicated pool recommended to guarantee tail latency with the 2x baseline.
- Ops: Need a single S3 destination + a manifest format for audit timeline. Also request a POC transfer window: 48 hours for a dry-run handoff.

Attachment: estimated_log_volume_breakdown.xlsx (detailed by service/component)

I9ll flag any infra constraints if we see higher than 45 TB/month.

—Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
